title: A stop during the prepared-Begin acknowledgement records an unsent grant as possibly begun
outcome: The begin-requested marker is set only once the prepared-Begin acknowledgement has succeeded, or the docs state that a hold arising during preparation may read as possibly begun. A runtime stop or abandon during the fence wait then no longer copies a grant that was never sent into uncertain_grant_id without saying so.
acceptance: A stop during the prepared-Begin acknowledgement records an unsent grant as possibly begun is done
